learning_outcomes.text: He/she is familiar with the definite and indefinite integral concepts.
He/she knows the basic integration rules and methods.
He/she can apply the integration techniques that he/she knows to science and engineering.
He/she knows sequence and series and can examine their convergence.

syllabus_topics: Techniques of Integration (Change of Variables, Integration by Parts)
Techniques of Integration (Partial Fractions, Trigonometric transformations)
Applications of Definite Integrals (Volume, Surface Area)
Applications of Definite Integrals (Length of a curve, Center of Mass, Work)
Convergence Tests for series, power series
